performance.verdict: ROAS holds at 5.28x but purchase volume is structurally thinning, not just spend-driven.

findings.text: 3-day purchase signal (Sep 15–17): 3, 0, 2 purchases vs prior 3 days (Sep 12–14): 2, 0, 1 — volume thin but not collapsing; ROAS up 1.21% despite -27.27% purchase drop means avg order value is lifting, not efficiency.
SOW: Funnel test + UTM live (Aug 31 deadline) overdue — /halal-subscribe conversion test result unreported, blocking subscribe-page web work and attribution clarity.
SOW: Pre-launch gate (Aug 31), platform ownership audit (Aug 31), and Aug 14 live-cooking event all overdue with no completed event recorded — three deliverables stalled across Admin, CRM, and Video.
GBP actions collapsed -58.97% week-over-week; last 3 days show 4, 0, 0 actions vs 27–30/day earlier in September — organic local discovery effectively dark for 3 days.

Spend averaging $53.09/day (7d) against a series baseline near $57–62/day; the -9.99% pullback reduced delivery but ROAS held, suggesting the top campaign (BWS - Sales - Muslims, $837.62 of $1,485.72) is carrying efficiency while reach narrows.

suggestions.text: Escalate funnel test closure: retrieve ihbp8pmtn8 conversion data and fire UTM tagging — blocks attribution and subscribe-page work.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 3 consecutive zero-action days (Sep 15–17) — confirm profile status before attributing to organic seasonality.
